title: Copy-stage configuration
statement: For natural numbers $c,C$, a Boolean input list $x$, and a natural number $i$ with $i\le |x|$, define the configuration in the copy state with input-head position $i+1$ in the shifted indexing, each of the $c+1$ work tapes containing true exactly at integer positions $z$ with $0\le z<i$ and blank elsewhere, each work-head at position $i$, and empty output.
